description: This file defines a Worker class for managing background processing tasks in the Flowise project, including initializing data sources, setting up queues, handling worker lifecycle, and managing shutdown procedures.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: A class extending BaseCommand to manage worker processes for prediction and upsertion tasks, including setup, error handling, and shutdown procedures.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to start worker processes, initialize queues, and set up event listeners.

methods.name: prepareData
methods.description: Initializes database, pools, telemetry, and other resources needed for worker operation.

methods.name: catch
methods.description: Handles errors during worker execution, logs error stack, and triggers exit.

methods.name: stopProcess
methods.description: Gracefully shuts down prediction and upsertion workers, handling errors during shutdown.
